summary: Fire tower on Bald Mountain in Westmore, Vermont: a 1921 tower, then a steel tower dated 1938-40; restored 2002 onward; NHLR-registered 2014; standing.

facts.design: Steel tower with a summit cab; wooden components replaced with white oak in 2024
facts.agency: Vermont Department of Forests, Parks, and Recreation (manages Willoughby State Forest, per Wikipedia)

access.note: NHLR 2016 visit report: directions to the summit and blazes on the Long Pond Trail are signed. No closure or booking notice found in the sources read; check with the state forest office.

notes_for_editor: Elevation differs: NHLR gives 3,304 ft (1,007 m), which the record and story use; Wikipedia gives 3315 ft for the same peak. Not reconciled. Build history: the NHLR detail page gives no build year. Forest Lookouts, quoting a 1921 state report, has a tower and telephone line on Westmore Mountain that year, and a new steel tower built by the New England Forest Emergency fund in work dated 1938-40. Whether the standing tower is the 1938-40 steel tower, or whether the 1921 tower was replaced, is not stated in any source read. The NorthWoods Stewardship Center page cited by the 2013 and 2024 chapter reports returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The Ranger's Cabin (2013 report), the summit cabin (2002 and 2016 reports, 2025 roof) may be the same building; sources read do not say. 2016 condition conflict: the NHLR visit report of August 21, 2016 describes cab graffiti, bullet holes and a portion of the roof blown off, while the chapter's October 2016 hike found the tower and summit cabin in good shape. Roof: the 2008, 2010 and 2012 chapter reports call for repair or replacement; the 2022 report says replaced 'last year', read as 2021, which is an inference. Agency: Wikipedia says the forest is managed by Vermont DFPR; the 2022 chapter report calls the tower state-owned. The tower's own managing agency is not named in the sources read. Access: signed route from the 2016 NHLR visit report and the 2025 report are the newest; no current closure, staffing or booking notice was read. Staffing: the NHLR visit report has a Staffed? question; not used as a fact. Budget: four fetch_text page reads (NHLR, Forest Lookouts, the 2025 chapter report, Wikipedia) plus one blocked NorthWoods page; two WebSearch calls; the other chapter reports were read from the local cache with pdftotext -layout. No new photos added; the record photo is from the NHLR (Jack Kelley, all rights reserved).
